title: Dispensing Limits by PrairieRx Plan (Network Pharmacy Schedule)
content:
This schedule of the Pharmacy Benefit sets, plan by plan, the monthly fill cap, the supply that one fill may cover, the dispensing channels and the claim reversal window that network pharmacies work within.

### Table A — Monthly cap on paid fills

| PrairieRx plan | Monthly cap applies | Most paid fills in one calendar month | Fills that count toward the cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | No | 0 (no cap) | Not applicable |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | Yes | 6 | All drugs |
| PrairieRx Adult | Yes | 6 | Brand drugs only |
| PrairieRx Children | No | 0 (no cap) | Not applicable |
| PrairieRx Maternity | No | 0 (no cap) | Not applicable |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | No | 0 (no cap) | Not applicable |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | No | 0 (no cap) | Not applicable |

### Table B — Supply per fill, channels and reversals

| PrairieRx plan | Most days supply of one non-maintenance fill | 90-day maintenance fill after two 34-day fills | Maintenance drugs by mail | Specialty drugs only at the designated specialty pharmacy | A-rated generic dispensed unless brand medically necessary is approved | Reversal window (calendar days after the fill date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrairieRx Dual Wrap | 34 | No | No | No | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Expansion Adult | 34 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Adult | 34 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Children | 34 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Maternity | 34 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Complex Care | 34 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 90 |
| PrairieRx Long-Term Care | 14 | No | No | Yes | Yes | 90 |

### Schedule notes

- A cap of 0 is entered where no monthly cap applies; it never means that no fill may be paid.
- On PrairieRx Adult the cap counts brand drugs only, so preferred generic fills are outside it; on PrairieRx Expansion Adult every drug counts.
- PrairieRx Long-Term Care is the one plan whose single fill covers at most 14 days.
